name: ModelVariant446_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant446_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (the header-412 entry shape with five ribbons, five trails, two sets of ten sheets and twenty-four sprites); for a non-negative request it selects the configuration record at data + 0xFC indexed by the request and packs four texture images, otherwise it runs one frame and calls the paired-sheet, sheet, ribbon and trailing-ribbon helpers from the configuration start; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the French header-463/613 images build the same source through french_model_variant/variant463_entry.c with VERSION_FRENCH and GCC 2.8.1, and bind the paired-sheet and sheet helpers 4 and 0x10 higher and the data 0x14 higher. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
